counts_for: P4 rounds only; R2 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110

wall_clock_bound: 4 turns; each run at most 900 s; one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or 4 runs have been trained and evaluated, or 4 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py under setsid; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
after: every evaluation's drawn targets are compared with the held-out receipt; a mismatch voids that evaluation
